verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for cap-table and equity-management software, so the story applies to Pulley. However, the evidence pack describes only Pulley's hosted SaaS features (cap tables, SAFEs, 409A valuations, liquidity programs) and contains no mention of a self-hosted, on-premise or open-source deployment option.
